AROGYA_SANJEEVANI.policy_name: IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani Standard Health Policy

rules.description: Room, Boarding and Nursing Expenses: 2% of Sum Insured subject to maximum of ₹5,000/- per day.
Intensive Care Unit (ICU) / ICCU expenses: 5% of Sum Insured subject to maximum of ₹10,000/- per day.
Pre-hospitalization medical expenses incurred for up to 30 days prior to admission.
Post-hospitalization medical expenses incurred for up to 60 days following discharge.
Initial waiting period of 30 days from date of inception of policy (except accidental injuries).
24-month waiting period for specified ailments including Benign ENT disorders, Cholecystectomy, Calculus diseases.
Fixed 5% co-pay applicable to each and every admissible claim.
Cataract treatment capped at 25% of Sum Insured or ₹40,000 per eye, whichever is lower.

CARE_PLUS.policy_name: Care Plus Comprehensive Health Insurance Policy

rules.description: Single Private AC Room up to ₹7,000/- per day; Normal Ward up to ₹4,000/- per day.
ICU or Intensive Cardiac Care Unit (ICCU) charges covered up to ₹15,000/- per day.
30 days initial waiting period from inception for all illnesses except accidental trauma.
24-month waiting period for Cholecystectomy, Hernia, and Calculus disorders.
Robotic surgeries and modern medical technologies capped at ₹1,50,000/- per policy year.

OPTIMA_SHIELD.policy_name: Optima Shield Standard Health Insurance Policy

rules.description: For SI below ₹5,00,000: Room rent capped at 1% of SI (maximum ₹4,000/- per day). For SI ≥ ₹5,00,000: No room rent capping.
ICU covered up to 2% of SI per day with absolute maximum ceiling of ₹10,000/- per day.
30-Day inception moratorium for any illness except acute trauma.
24-month waiting period for Gallbladder stone surgery, Knee replacement, and spine surgeries.
Cataract surgical correction capped at ₹35,000/- per eye.
